data.title: Internal Sales Consultant - Life
data.description:
What You Can Expect In This Role

Provide frontline sales support for distribution channels including Personal Producing General Agent (PPGA), Direct, Independent Broker Dealer (IBD), and Managing General Agent (MGA) Brokerage channels. As a subject matter expert, actively consult and educate on case design, product selection, website and company resources, illustration software, approved digital sales tools, and any additional resources that enable the sales process.
What You'll Do In This Role

• Respond to field calls and inquiries providing education and support on products, marketing and sales materials, sales concepts, product education, advanced illustration support, and other sales enablement resources.
• Utilize a consultative approach to recommend appropriate solutions to Agents and/or MGA office staff with case design, product selection, marketing resources, and approved selling tools to capitalize on opportunities to enhance relationships, build customer loyalty, and ultimately grow sales.
• Maintain a solutions based mentality when handling incoming calls/e-mails and ensure that each interaction includes the promotion of any applicable company products as well as an attempt to capture additional sales opportunities.
• Use online programs to provide technical support and problem solving to resolve field issues related to all sales enablement platforms. Ensure escalated issues are routed to proper departments or vendor for resolution.
• Track and document all field interactions in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system, which provides a holistic view of our agent’s company interactions and their experience. Provide insight and feedback to Sales and Marketing leadership regarding product competitiveness, customer satisfaction, industry trends, and other opportunities to engage the field.
• Make proactive outbound telephone calls to agents/advisors to increase product awareness, marketing campaigns and new product launches, and other attempts to strengthen relationships and build brand loyalty with key distribution partners in all channels.
• Assist in the onboarding process for newly appointed Agents and MGAs by offering and delivering successful training programs and educational support for new products, services, and programs offered by the company. Participate in outbound call campaigns, virtual sales presentations, and development of recorded video messaging.
• Recommend illustration software enhancements based on data obtained from our field force and personal experiences in using company and vendor illustration software platforms.
• Responsible for illustration software user acceptance testing and quality assurance. Also provide technical support to the field for questions/issues related to the sales illustration software.
• Maintain a working knowledge of competitor products and offerings and understand the key differentiators for Midland National and North American.
• Work with managers on ongoing projects, such as conducting presentations on noticeable market trends and brainstorming on ways to redirect product placement in the market for increased sales.
• Create and present virtual conference meetings as assigned.
• Proactively cross-sell additional Sammons Financial Group Company's products to PPGA producers or MGA’s.
• Participate in external meetings and presentations.
• Commitment to embrace Sammons Financial Group Companies shared values (Accountability, Connection, Openness, Respect and Integrity).
• As stated within the Company Attendance and Punctuality policy, regular attendance is required and expected in order to meet the business service levels and workflow demands.
• Other duties as assigned.
What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree Preferred
  • 1-2 years' relevant work experience Preferred
  • Background in life insurance sales or customer service preferred
  • Proven ability to build and maintain effective internal and external relationships
  • Complete knowledge of the sales process
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proven ability to work in a fast paced call center environment
  • Effective written and oral communication skills
  • Computer Skills including, but not limited to, Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint
  • State Life Insurance license or ability to obtain within 120 Days Preferred

Other Requirements

• Criminal background check required.

Salary Range Information

USD $44,498.00 - USD $74,162.00 /Yr.
What you can expect when you join Sammons Financial Group

• Comprehensive health coverage for you and your family, including Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA & FSA options, and term life insurance.
• Competitive compensation with a performance-based incentive program tied to clear goals and individual and/or company success.
• Invest in your future with our 100% company-funded Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), plus automatic enrollment in our 401(k).
• Work–life balance that means something. Friday afternoons off year-round, generous paid time off, and paid holidays.
• Commit to your growth with paid development time, tuition reimbursement, and professional development opportunities across industry, individual, and leadership programs.
• Make an impact beyond the workplace through volunteer time off, and our company nonprofit matching gift program, supporting the causes that matter most to you.
• An ownership culture that inspires; join a connected, values-driven workplace where employees take accountability, support one another, and are empowered to do their best work—together shaping our future shared success.

Work Authorization/Sponsorship

At this time, we’re not considering candidates that need any type of immigration sponsorship now or in the future or those needing work authorization for this role (This includes, but is not limited to students on F1-OPT, F1-CPT, J-1, etc.)
Additional Information

Sammons Financial Group Is An Equal Opportunity Employer
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

ADA
Sammons Financial Group is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of the employment process. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the application or hiring process, including navigating our website or applying for a position, please contact HR@sfgmembers.com or call 800-728-2987.

E-Verify
Sammons Financial Group participates in E-Verify and will provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security with information from each new employee's Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

Policy for External Search Firms and Agencies
Sammons Financial Group maintains an internal Talent Acquisition function and does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from search firms, staffing agencies, or other third-party recruiting vendors. Please review our Recruitment Agency Policy for additional information here.

data.title: Sr Compliance Consultant - Testing & Surveillance
data.description:
What You Can Expect In This Role

This role is responsible for conducting and enhancing compliance testing and monitoring across the organization’s investment adviser, broker-dealer, and registered investment company compliance programs. You will independently plan and execute risk-based reviews, evaluate the effectiveness of compliance controls, identify potential gaps, and work with business and compliance partners to develop practical solutions and drive remediation. The ideal candidate brings experience across investment adviser and broker-dealer compliance and is comfortable analyzing complex requirements, identifying risk, and communicating findings to a range of stakeholders.


What You'll Do In This Role

  • Develop and execute risk-based compliance testing and monitoring across investment adviser, broker-dealer, and registered investment company activities.
  • Independently plan testing engagements, including defining scope, identifying applicable requirements and controls, selecting samples, documenting testing, and evaluating results.
  • Assess the design and effectiveness of compliance policies, procedures, supervisory processes, and internal controls.
  • Support the organization’s 38a-1 compliance program, including testing, documentation, deficiency tracking, remediation, and annual compliance reporting.
  • Support investment adviser compliance reviews and monitoring, including activities related to the effectiveness of the compliance program and identified regulatory risks.
  • Conduct broker-dealer testing and monitoring related to supervisory controls, sales practices, communications, registration and licensing, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Analyze reports, transactions, exception activity, and other data to identify potential regulatory, compliance, or control concerns.
  • Clearly document testing methodology, results, findings, and conclusions in accordance with established compliance standards.
  • Identify control gaps, trends, and root causes and work with business and compliance partners to develop appropriate corrective actions.
  • Track identified findings and remediation activities through resolution and validate corrective actions when appropriate.
  • Communicate testing results, findings, and recommendations clearly to Compliance leadership, business partners, Legal, and other stakeholders.
  • Lead or contribute to compliance risk assessments and use identified risks to help inform testing and monitoring priorities.
  • Recommend and implement enhancements to testing methodologies, monitoring activities, controls, workflows, and documentation.
  • Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, due diligence requests, and other reviews by providing testing documentation and subject matter expertise.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess whether changes to testing, monitoring, policies, or controls are needed.
  • Lead compliance projects and program enhancements related to areas of responsibility.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Internal Audit, and the business to identify issues, resolve concerns, and strengthen the overall compliance program.
  • Embrace Sammons Financial Group Companies’ shared values of Accountability, Connection, Openness, Respect, and Integrity.
  • Maintain regular attendance in accordance with the Company Attendance and Punctuality Policy to meet business service levels and workflow demands.
  • Participate in other compliance initiatives and projects as needed.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, risk management, legal studies, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Typically, 7 to 10 years of experience in compliance, risk management, regulatory affairs, internal audit, or a related financial services role.
  • Compliance experience supporting investment advisers, broker-dealers, or registered investment companies, with experience across multiple regulatory frameworks strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of SEC and FINRA requirements applicable to investment advisers, broker-dealers, and registered investment companies.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting compliance testing, monitoring, risk assessments, control reviews, or similar assurance activities.
  • Experience with 38a-1 compliance programs, registered investment companies, or registered separate accounts preferred.
  • Ability to design and execute testing independently, analyze results, identify meaningful issues, and reach well-supported conclusions.
  • Experience identifying control gaps, developing recommendations, tracking remediation, and validating corrective actions.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and apply them to business processes and controls.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to analyze data, identify patterns and exceptions, and translate findings into practical compliance recommendations.
  • Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate findings and difficult messages effectively and professionally.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with business partners and stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple reviews and projects, set priorities, and follow work through to completion.
  • Attention to detail and a consistent approach to testing documentation and workpapers.
  • Knowledge of insurance operations, variable insurance products, registered separate accounts, or insurance regulations is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn compliance testing, monitoring, data analytics, and regulatory systems.
  • Series License-6 and Series License-26 Or
  • Series License-7 and Series License-24 or ability to obtain within 120 Days Required
  • Some travel to company offices and conferences annually required.

Other Requirements

• Criminal background check required.
• If the position is in the SIG business unit, Annuity New Business Securities team, or if we are holding securities licenses, FINRA regulations require fingerprinting for this position; if we are holding securities licenses, a credit check will also be required. Management reserves the right to determine and approve incumbent suitability for this position.

Salary Range Information

USD $61,622.00 - USD $128,378.00 /Yr. Range includes data points from multiple labor markets. Specific range is dependent on the labor market where the incumbent will be hired to perform the position. Starting salary is dependent on candidate qualifications and experience. For a narrower salary range specific to your labor market, please inquire.
What you can expect when you join Sammons Financial Group

• Comprehensive health coverage for you and your family, including Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA & FSA options, and term life insurance.
• Competitive compensation with a performance-based incentive program tied to clear goals and individual and/or company success.
• Invest in your future with our 100% company-funded Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), plus automatic enrollment in our 401(k).
• Work–life balance that means something. Friday afternoons off year-round, generous paid time off, and paid holidays.
• Commit to your growth with paid development time, tuition reimbursement, and professional development opportunities across industry, individual, and leadership programs.
• Make an impact beyond the workplace through volunteer time off, and our company nonprofit matching gift program, supporting the causes that matter most to you.
• An ownership culture that inspires; join a connected, values-driven workplace where employees take accountability, support one another, and are empowered to do their best work—together shaping our future shared success.

data.title: Suitability Review Consultant
data.description:
What You Can Expect In This Role

Conduct suitability reviews of annuity new business applications while managing escalated files, replacement monitoring, heightened reviews, trend analysis and agent outreach to ensure compliance with National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) suitability, state and federal regulations.
What You'll Do In This Role

• Determine the suitability for annuity new business applications. Gather additional information for analysis, evaluate and make final suitability recommendations and decisions and extensively document decisions and actions taken. Decide when to involve management for limited items outside scope of authority.
• Provide leadership and direction to the Suitability Review Consultants including, but not limited to workload management, coaching, training and case review support.
• Provide individualized case management, level back office service and support to our top producers by directly working with the agents and their staff on all Suitability questions, pre-sale reviews and decline conversations.
• Maintain and provide updates to team on written procedures in compliance with regulations to ensure accurate, efficient and consistent processing of the suitability review workload.
• Maintain comprehensive knowledge of company offered annuity products (i.e. variable, fixed and fixed indexed) as well as external financial products. Provide Suitability Review Consultant support by utilizing overall product knowledge and expertise.
• Complete heightened reviews on agent’s books of business to ensure consistency in our review process. Analyze results and find trends and patterns; share results and recommendations with management and the Review Committee.
• Assist with monthly quality assurance (QA) of the suitability phone and review process to ensure procedures and guidelines are being followed. Provide mentorship through coaching and assisting team members with heightened reviews of individual cases and agents. Collaborate with corresponding team member regarding feedback resulting from quality reviews.
• Assist management with the annual re-certification/audit of third party distributors to ensure functions are being performed as requested and are compliant with applicable laws, rules and regulations. Seek support as necessary from internal suitability governance team. Review the ongoing monitoring of banks, broker-dealers and other external distribution partners.
• Assist the Compliance team with reviewing files on post issue complaints.
• Provide subject matter expertise to IT and Agile project teams by participating and facilitating meetings, creating stories, performing user acceptance testing, and executing business approval.
• Support all other Annuity New Business teams when volume and capacity allows.
• Accept and manage any calls and escalations from our distribution partners professionally and autonomously.
• Assist leader with additional research requests in regards to escalated cases and follow up with agents and business partners when requested.
• Review auxiliary reports related to the Suitability department. Provide timely and comprehensive feedback to management and other suitability consultants regarding these reports.
• Commitment to embrace Sammons Financial Group Companies shared values (Accountability, Connection, Openness, Respect and Integrity).
• As stated within the Company Attendance and Punctuality policy, regular attendance is required and expected in order to meet the business service levels and workflow demands.
• Other duties as assigned.
What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree Preferred
  • Minimum 5 years' Broker dealer back office, annuity or insurance client service experience Preferred
  • Previous suitability or compliance experience Preferred
  • Proficient use of PC and Microsoft Office products
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent analytical problem solving skills with the ability to make decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to influence others
  • Advanced organizational skills with ability to focus on appropriate details
  • Self-motivator and ability to work efficiently and independently to meet service levels
  • Ability to adapt to frequent change
  • Ability to work periodic overtime, sometimes with relatively short notice
  • Series 6 and Series 26 licenses (or Series 7 and 24) or ability to obtain within 120 days Required
  • FINRA SIE Preferred
  • Some travel may be required

Other Requirements

• Due to the financial nature and level of accountability of this position, a credit and criminal background check is required - The Fair Credit Reporting Act requires Sammons Financial Group Companies to notify you that, as a routine part of processing this application for employment, Sammons Financial Group may request a consumer report on you to verify all information contained in this application. Such report may include information about work-related behaviors, performance, character, general reputation, and personal characteristics, in addition to information about your previous employment, education, credit history and criminal records
• FINRA regulations require fingerprinting for this position. Management reserves the right to determine and approve incumbent suitability for this position.

Salary Range Information

USD $62,571.00 - USD $104,284.00 /Yr. Range includes data points from multiple labor markets. Specific range is dependent on the labor market where the incumbent will be hired to perform the position. Starting salary is dependent on candidate qualifications and experience. For a narrower salary range specific to your labor market, please inquire.

• Competitive compensation with a performance-based incentive program tied to clear goals and individual and/or company success.
